EXCLUSIVE RIGHT TO SELL LISTING AGREEMENT

This Exclusive Right to Sell Listing Agreement is made on June 2, 2026, between Rosalind Ferreira-Nakagawa and Emeka Ferreira-Nakagawa (together, "Seller"), owners of the real property at 2214 Windermere Crescent, Boise, Idaho 83702 (the "Property"), and Alderwood Realty Group LLC, an Idaho limited liability company (the "Broker"), acting through its designated broker Tobias Quillon-Reyes.

1. GRANT AND LISTING PERIOD

Seller grants Broker the exclusive right to sell the Property. The listing period begins on June 2, 2026 and expires at 11:59 p.m. on December 2, 2026, unless extended by a writing signed by both parties. This is an exclusive right to sell listing, not an exclusive agency listing and not an open listing: Broker earns the commission stated in Section 2 on a sale during the listing period regardless of who procures the buyer, including a sale procured by Seller.

2. LIST PRICE AND COMMISSION

The list price is $875,000, and Seller may change it by written notice to Broker.

Seller shall pay Broker a commission of five percent (5%) of the gross sales price. The commission is earned when a buyer ready, willing, and able to purchase on the price and terms of this Agreement, or on other terms Seller accepts, signs a purchase and sale agreement Seller also signs. The commission is payable at closing out of the sale proceeds. If Seller defaults and the sale does not close, the commission remains earned and is payable on the date the sale would have closed. If the buyer defaults and Seller retains the earnest money, Seller shall pay Broker one half of the retained earnest money, not to exceed the full commission, in full satisfaction of Broker's claim for that transaction.

Broker's compensation is not set by law and is fully negotiable. Broker offers cooperating compensation to a buyer's broker in an amount Seller approves in writing, currently two and one-half percent (2.5%) of the gross sales price, and any such offer is made outside the Multiple Listing Service.

3. PROTECTION PERIOD

If, within ninety (90) days after the expiration or termination of the listing period, Seller sells or contracts to sell the Property to a person who was shown the Property or who submitted an offer during the listing period, Seller shall pay the commission stated in Section 2.

Broker shall deliver to Seller, within ten (10) days after the expiration or termination of the listing period, a written list of every such registered prospect. Broker's right to a commission under this Section applies only to a person named in that list. This Section does not apply if the Property is listed with another broker after expiration on a bona fide arm's-length basis and that broker earns a commission on the sale.

4. AGENCY DISCLOSURE AND DUAL AGENCY

Broker represents Seller as Seller's agent. Broker has provided Seller the agency disclosure brochure required by Idaho Code § 54-2085, and Seller acknowledges receiving and reading it before signing this Agreement.

Broker may also represent a buyer of the Property. Seller consents to that dual agency, and Seller understands that in a dual agency Broker may not disclose to either party the other's willingness to accept a different price or terms, may not advocate the interests of one party over the other, and owes both parties the duties of honesty, good faith, and reasonable care. Seller's consent is given by Seller's informed written consent below and may be revoked by written notice at any time before an offer is presented. Broker may instead assign a designated agent to Seller and another designated agent to the buyer, each of whom represents only that party.

5. MLS AND MARKETING AUTHORIZATIONS

Seller authorizes Broker to submit the Property to the Intermountain Multiple Listing Service and to any other MLS in which Broker participates, to publish the listing and its photographs on the Internet and on third-party display sites, to place a yard sign and a lockbox on the Property, to hold open houses, to photograph and video the interior and exterior including aerial images, and to report the sale price and terms to the MLS after closing. Seller may opt out of Internet display or of the display of the address by delivering the MLS opt-out form to Broker, and Seller has not done so.

6. SELLER'S OBLIGATIONS AND REPRESENTATIONS

Seller shall refer to Broker every inquiry about the Property received during the listing period, shall make the Property available for showing on reasonable notice, shall complete the Idaho seller property disclosure form within ten (10) days, and shall disclose to Broker every known material defect, lien, encumbrance, and pending assessment. Seller represents that Seller has good and marketable title, that the Property is not subject to another listing agreement, and that Seller has authority to sell.

7. FAIR HOUSING AND EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

The Property is offered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, familial status, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other class protected by federal, state, or local law.

8. TERMINATION

Either party may terminate this Agreement for the other's material breach on ten (10) days written notice, if the breach is not cured within that period. Termination does not affect Broker's rights under Section 3 or a commission already earned.

9. DISPUTES AND GENERAL

This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Idaho. Any dispute arising out of this Agreement shall be submitted to mediation before either party may file suit, and any suit shall be brought in the courts of Ada County, Idaho. This Agreement is the entire agreement of the parties concerning the listing and may be amended only in a writing signed by both parties.
